smin gling lo chen rin po che'i bka' brgyad bsnyen yig khro sgrub skabs kyi sgom khog nag 'gros su bris pa bzhugs/dang po ting nge 'dzin gsum las

tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250smin gling lo chen rin po che'i bka' brgyad bsnyen yig khro sgrub skabs kyi sgom khog nag 'gros su bris pa bzhugs/ 1$0000300

dang po ting nge 'dzin gsum las de bzhin nyid ni/ hūm̐/ rnam dag byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin ni// gdod nas ma skyes ye gdal gting mtha' med// mi gnas mi dmigs spros pa med pa'i ngang*// brjod med bsam 'das mnyam nyid dbyings su rdzogs// oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag pa'i stong pa nyid la mnyam par bzhag /kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ thams cad snying po byang chub sems nyid la/ gzung 'dzin mtshan ma rdul tsam mi dmigs kyang*// rtsol med dbyings las 'gag pa med pa'i phyir// sgyu ma'i phyag rgya bye brag cir yang gsal// āḥdharma dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ rang bzhin de ma rtogs pa'i 'gro ba rnams la brtse ba'i snying rje chen po kun tu khyab par snang ba'o// rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ chos nyid dbyings su thams cad sangs rgyas shing*// skye med bde chen ngang du ro gcig kyang*// skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'bar ba'i byin rlabs kyis// rang rig ye shes chos sku mngon du shar// hūm̐ badz+ra tsit+ta hūm̐/ stong nyid snying rje zung du 'jug pa'i rang mdangs hūm̐ yig mthing nag nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ gnyis pa rten gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig las e yaṃ ra suṃ keṃ raṃ rnams chad pa las/ e ā ka sha maṇ+ḍa la/ yaṃ wā yu maṇ+ḍa la/ ra rak+ta maṇ+ḍa la/ suṃ ti ra maṇ+ḍa la/ kiṃ ni ri ti maṇ+ḍa la/ raṃ dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ zhes pas rten gyi dkyil 'khor de nyid gsal gdab pa ni/ e las nam mkha' mthing nag 'byams klas dbyings// yaṃ las rlung dkyil ljang nag rgya gram g.yo// de steng ra las khrag mtsho dmar zlum 'khrugs// suṃ las zhing chen sa gzhi gru bzhir gdal// keṃ las rus pa'i ri rab bang rim bzhi// raṃ las bskal pa'i me chen 'bar ba'i klong// paṃ las 'dab stong pad+ma'i ge sar la// hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje sra zhing brtan// de steng mkha' las bh+rūm̐ yig lnga ldan babs// bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhe rat+na bhañdza dzñā na tsakra maṇ+ḍa la bh+rūm̐// bh+rūm̐ yig yongs gyur rin chen gzhal yas khang*// gru bzhi sgo bzhi shel gser rā ga dang*// margad bai ḍūr+ya yi rang bzhin can// rdo rje nor bu'i rtsig steng rin po che'i// pha gu ser po de steng mu tig gi

/drwa ba drwa phyed shar bu mda' yab mdzes/ khang brtsegs phyur bur rdo rje nor bu'i tog /sna tshogs rin chen 'od 'phro rmang gi gzhir// 'dod snam dmar por gzung ma bcu drug 'khod// sgo bzhir ka ba bzhis btegs twa ra ṇa// bang rim brgyad ldan chos 'khor ri dwags gdugs// ngo mtshar kun tu bzang po'i rgyan bkod pa'i// gzhal yas khang nang rdo rje'i gdung bzhi yis// mig mang ris bris so so'i nang khongs su// dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang pa dgu /rim gsum thod pa'i rtsig par khrag zhag 'bab// sha chen 'dod snam pha gur thod pas dkrigs// rkang lag shar bu sgal tshigs mda' yab can// rgyu rlon rus pa'i drwa phyed thod tshal 'phyang*// mi ro'i rgyal mtshan 'phan gdugs tsit+ta'i tog /lha klu'i ka gdung gza' skar dral phyam byas// zhing lpags thog phub nya sbrul za ra tshags// rab 'jigs pho brang kun dbus mthing nag e// rtsibs bzhi mu khyud khyams dang bcas pa 'o// phyi rol 'khor yug dur khrod chen po brgyad// mchod rten shing me sprin chu grub pa brgyad// lha klu phyogs skyong ma mo zhing skyong dang*// sha za ro langs gsar rnying bam ro'i tshal// de mthar gzhom med rdo rje srung ba'i gur// mi phyed rab 'bar phreng ba 'khrigs pas bskor// gsum pa gdan bskyed pa ni/ ru dra kro dhī ti ra baṃ/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍa la/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍa la/ pho brang lte bar pad+ma'i ge gsar la// rab 'bar nyi ma dkar gsal zla ba'i dkyil// ma hā de ba u ma de bīr bcas// phyogs mtshams brgyad por pad+ma nyi zla'i steng*// ru dra chu glang klu dbang lha chen po// ma mo dar zab dregs pa dgra bgegs rnams// pho mo kha bub gan rkyal bsnol mar gyur// bzhi pa brten pa lha bskyed pa ni/ rgyu'i hūm̐ yig gdan steng babs pa las che mchog dang*/ de'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ spros te dkyil 'khor brgyad po'i gtso bo rnams bsgom/

de thams cad hūm̐ las skad cig dran rdzogs su bskyed cing*/ 'khor rnams rang rang gi gtso bo'i 'khor la rang bzhin gyis gnas pa'i tshul du bskyed par sgom khog dang 'grel par gsungs pa ltar 'di skad ces/ nam mkhar gnas pa'i hūm̐ yig dbus kyi gdan la babs pa yongs su gyur pa las khrag 'thung thams cad 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs dpal chen po'i skur gyur par bsams la/ hūm̐/ dbus phyogs mi 'gyur mthing nag e dbyings su/ khrag 'thung 'dus pa'i spyi gzugs dpal chen po// che mchog mthing nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal// phyag drug rtse dgu rtse lnga rtse gsum g.yas// skra can thod rlon dung dmar g.yon na bsnams// gnam zhal kha ṭ+wāṃ thod khrag stob pas 'khyud// rtsibs bzhi rigs kyi khrag 'thung yum bcas gsal// oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ che mchog yab yum thugs las mthing nag hūm̐// phyogs mtshams dkyil 'khor brgyad kyi lte bar spros// yongs gyur dpal chen khrag 'thung gtso bo brgyad// rang rang 'khor dang bcas pa gsal bar gyur// hūm̐/ shar phyogs dkyil 'khor dbus su ru dra'i steng*// yang dag mthing nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal// phyag drug rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rnge'u chung g.yas// dril bu bhan dmar rgyu zhags g.yon na bsnams// kro dhī shwa rī kha ṭ+wāṃ thod 'dzin 'khyud// rtsibs la rigs bzhi'i khrag 'thung yab yum 'khod// oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐/ lho phyogs dkyil 'khor dbus su chu glang steng*// gshin rje mthing nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal// phyag drug be con ral gri dgra s+t+wa g.yas// bhan dmar sdigs mdzub mdung thung g.yon na bsnams// bai tā dgra s+t+wa bhan dmar stob pas 'khyud// ral gcig rtse gsum thod 'dzin g.yas su 'khod// rtsibs la gshed bzhi rang rang yum bcas 'khod// oṃ ā kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭa/

hūm̐/ nub phyogs dkyil 'khor dbus su klu chen steng*// rta mgrin dmar nag g.yas dkar g.yon sngo zhal// phyag drug rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ sbrul zhags g.yas// dril bu dung dmar lcags sgrog g.yon na bsnams// pad+ma zil gnon kha ṭ+wāṃ thod 'dzin 'khyud// rtsibs bzhir g.yas g.yon byi la pu shud gdong*// mdun rgyab rdo rje pad+ma gar dbang 'khod// oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta badz+ra kro dha ha ya grī wa hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐/ byang phyogs dkyil 'khor dbus su lha chen steng*// phur pa mthing nag g.yas dkar g.yon dmar zhal// phyag drug g.yas gnyis rtse dgu rtse lnga dang*// g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭ+wāṃ mtha' gnyis kyis// phur bu dril 'debs rdo rje'i gshog pa gdengs// 'khor lo rgyas 'debs kha ṭ+wāṃ thod 'dzin 'khyud// rtsibs la rigs kyi kī la ya bzhi 'khod// oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nāṃ baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐/ shar lho'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ma mo'i steng// bla med khrag 'thung mthing nag dkar dmar zhal// phyag drug rdo rje khyung chen sbrul zhags g.yas// bhan dmar zhing g.yab thod pa'i ga 'u g.yon// mu kha mthing nag zhal lnga dkar ser dmar// ljang gu mthing nag phyag drug rdo rje dang*// gri zhags bum pa g.yas 'dzin dril bu dang*// bhan dmar g.yang gzhi yab 'khyud zhabs brgyad bgrad// gtso bo'i g.yas dang g.yon du bkrag gsal dang*// srid pa bde 'gro rtsibs la ma mo bzhi// oṃ gu h+ya dzñā na shrī he ru ka gu h+ya dzñā na kro dhī shwa rī s+t+waṃ ma ma yo gi nī ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐/ lho nub dkyil 'khor dbus su seng ge'i khrir// gsang ba'i bdag po rig 'dzin rdo rje chos// dkar gsal phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// dbu skra thor tshugs rin chen cod pan can// zi ldir smad g.yogs rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol// rtsibs la rigs kyi rig 'dzin rnam bzhi 'khod// oṃ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ phaṭa/

hūm̐/ nub byang dkyil 'khor dbus su dregs pa'i steng*// dregs 'dul mthing nag g.yas ser g.yon smug zhal// phyag drug rdo rje lha brgyad mgo bo g.yas// bhan dmar klu brgyad mgo bo g.yon na bsnams/ khams gsum spyi 'dul kha ṭ+wāṃ thod 'dzin 'khyud// rtsibs la dregs pa'i sde dpon chen po bzhi// oṃ badz+ra tsan+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭān hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐/ byang shar dkyil 'khor dbus su dgra bgegs steng// stobs ldan nag po zhal gsum mig sman mdog /phyag drug rdo rje lha brgyad tsit+ta g.yas// bhan dmar klu brgyad tsit+ta g.yon na bsnams// 'byung lnga'i bdag mo mthing nag phyag gnyis kyis// gzugs khams mkhar 'degs 'dod khams sa gzhir gnon// rtsibs la sngags bdag dregs pa'i sde dpon bzhi// oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭān hūm̐ phaṭa/ rig 'dzin ma gtogs dpal chen khrag 'thung kun// dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi mi bzad gzugs// gar dgus rnam rol zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs// dmar zlum spyan ldog smin ma ag tshoms 'bar// zhing chen glang lpags stod g.yogs stag sham 'phyang*// tshar gsum thod phreng sbrul brgyan phyag rgya drug /rak+ta zhag dang thal chen mtshan mas spras// dpal chen chas rdzogs yum rnams khro chags tshul// rngam brjid rgyan ldan rang rang yab dang sbyor// gtso 'khor thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems// de nang nyi steng rdo rje'i lte bar hūm̐// so so'i sngags phreng 'bar bas g.yas su bskor// dkyil 'khor phyi khyams shar sogs phyogs bzhi ru// zhi rgyas dbang drag ma mo drug drug dang*// sgo bzhir sgo skyong kun kyang phyogs kyi mdog /'jigs gzugs dur khrod chas ldan rang rtags 'dzin// phyi yi mu khyud mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis// ging chen bco brgyad laṅka bcu drug dang*// 'bar ma brgyad dang sa bdag sum cu gnyis// ma bdun sring bzhi pho nya drug cu bzhi// mkha' 'gro brtan ma phyogs skyong rgyal chen sogs// dpal gyi pho nya bsam gyis mi khyab pa// nyi ma las ni 'od zer ji bzhin du// rab 'byams nam mkha'i khams kun gang bar gyur// oṃ badz+ra sarba yak+sha sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/
